headline: Sensex Slips While Nifty Gains; Metals Shine Ahead Of Fed Decision
why: Anticipation of the upcoming US Federal Reserve interest rate decision
Strong performance in metal and FMCG sectors boosting Nifty indices
Profit booking in large-cap IT stocks dragging Sensex performance
Positive sentiment in small-cap stocks with nearly 1.8% jump
whatHappening: Jindal Supreme IPO witnessed massive investor interest, subscribed 181 times
Apple's iPhone 18 launch in India saw 20-30% higher sales
Direct tax collections grew 13% to Rs 12.12 lakh crore
Government targets 200 chip design firms under Semicon 2.0 scheme

stocksInNews.sources: Shares sink 7.5% on margin target cut
Metal stocks gain ahead of Fed call

summary:
The Indian market showed mixed results as Nifty gained while Sensex faced pressure from IT stocks.
Investor enthusiasm was evident in the Jindal Supreme IPO and strong iPhone 18 launch-day sales.
Global cues remain cautious due to geopolitical tensions in Ukraine and the upcoming Fed meeting.
